Full TEST-RUNNER pass for REQ-167 on branch feature/WF02-REQ167-20260828, commit 78d4101. Environment: Elixir 1.20.3 / OTP 29 (matches .tool-versions pin), PATH prefixed with asdf shims + cargo bin, WASMEX_BUILD=true. docker compose services (letflow-1-postgres-1, letflow-1-keycloak-1) were already running and healthy, Postgres on port 5463 per this workspace's untracked .env LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5463.

1) `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`: exit 0, no output (clean, already-compiled build, zero warnings).

2) `mix test test/letflow/engine/wasm/`: 'Result: 48 passed' -- matches the expected 18 (capability_gate_test.exs) + 20 (module_registry_test.exs) + 10 (plugin_handler_test.exs) = 48 total, 0 failures. Two Dialyzer-style 'incompatible types given to ModuleRegistry.register/1' compile-time type warnings appeared for module_registry_test.exs lines 366 and 370 -- these are expected/intentional: both tests deliberately call register/1 with nil and an integer to assert a FunctionClauseError guard, so the type-checker flagging the deliberately-wrong argument types is not a real issue and did not affect the --warnings-as-errors compile (that ran separately and passed clean).

3) Full suite via `scripts/test_parallel.sh` (N=8, derived from nproc; TEST_POOL_SIZE=10, computed from max_connections=100 - superuser_reserved=3 - headroom=10 - nonpool_reserve=2, divided by N=8): all 8 partitions reported exit 0 with 0 failures. Combined: 'combined: 2331 tests, 5 properties, 0 failures (2336/2336 passed)'. Per-partition breakdown: p1=347 tests/2 properties, p2=253/1, p3=274/2, p4=126/0, p5=278/0, p6=339/0, p7=352/0, p8=362/0, all 0 failures. No structural attribution needed -- there were no failures to attribute. Neither ISS-0287 (pool exhaustion) nor ISS-0351 (WASM registry timeout-path CPU spin) surfaced; no too_many_connections errors, no partition crashed before a Result: line, no unusually long runtime observed.

4) `mix letflow.lint_handoffs`: reported 'OK -- 0 new violations across 1237 handoff files (25 pre-existing grandfathered, traced to ISS-0190)'. The only hit matching this run_id's directory was a pre-existing [H-SIZE-2] under-specified warning on handoffs/WF02-REQ167-20260828/step-00-git-setup.json (not this step-04 file, not something I authored or am scoped to fix here). No violations flagged against step-04-test-runner.json itself.

5) No test report file written under test/reports/ -- the suite is a clean pass with 0 failures, so per this role's instructions ('a clean pass needs no report file') none was required.

Conclusion: all acceptance criteria met. REQ-167's WASM import-whitelist and filesystem-denial (WASM-06/WASM-07) implementation and its tests are verified green on a full-suite run, not just the targeted wasm subdirectory.
